# Local exact QFT request design

[draft-01.md](draft-01.md) preserves the read-only API audit and a proposed
bounded independent request experiment. It is non-normative and has no executed
QFT experiment results. [context.json](context.json) and
[inputs.json](inputs.json) identify the observed source subset and work scope;
[Issue #317 readback](issue-317.md) retains the actual upstream requirements.
The [connector response](issue-317.connector.json) is a normalized tool result,
not original HTTP bytes or an authenticated human adoption.

No production source, prior frozen authoring record, stdlib/corpus input,
primitive, Lean acceptance rule or guarantee record is changed. Later execution
must be separately coordinated and retain new observations without rewriting
this first design. The source map is a fixed inspected subset, not complete
runtime closure or an attestation that the current HEAD was compiled.
